beforeYouUpdate: After updating, run the connect command shown in each cluster's settings.
Skip the cluster Pyo runs on. Its server runs the command by itself.
Pyo's Postgres, ClickHouse, backup store and registry restart once during the update. Pyo is down for a short time.
Your KV databases restart once when their cluster gets this update.
Pyo Gateway restarts once on each server. Open WebSockets reconnect.
The Cloudflare Tunnel connector restarts once on each cluster that uses it.
The firewall restarts once on each server where a service uses it.
Each service's open WebSockets and streams drop once, the next time Pyo applies its routes.
Self-hosted sandbox servers stop taking commands after this update until an admin presses Update on each one and runs the command it shows on that server. Their sandboxes keep running.
